mathematical_results.isolation: sum over own pawn files f of n_f times indicator that adjacent own pawn files f-1 and f+1 are empty; counts doubled isolated pawns separately
mathematical_results.passed: each own pawn is passed iff no enemy pawn lies strictly forward in its own and adjacent files; equivalently WHITE rank>=max enemy rank; BLACK rank<=min enemy rank
mathematical_results.quiet_push_lemma: noncapturing, nonpromoting pawn pushes preserve own isolation, may increase own and opponent passed counts but cannot decrease either in the fixed-replay step; promotion excluded
mathematical_results.genesis: persistent pawn passes iff exact opposing forward blocker set changes nonempty -> empty
mathematical_results.identifiability: one rank-1 root contrast co-toggling nuisance predicates cannot isolate the passed-pawn or isolated-pawn contribution
